items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: I remember his name, his name was Mr. Sims.

ctx.x: What did he do for the living?

Well, he was, I would say, he's all around, because he could do anything with a house. He could build any kind of building. He could do repairs and all that, you know. And I remember the time he knew a lot about, he wasn't no doctor, but he knew a lot about curing people with things, you know. Because I remember they had a man just come to our house. I remember his name, his name was Mr. Sims. And the man had a big hole in his side there. And he had, he said he had been every doctor he could find, and he said he…
It was just one big room in the kitchen?
